protocol.space: 2D pixels in the upright 1408x1408 evaluation frame
protocol.projection: world -> device (MPS SLAM headset_trajectory) -> camera (T_Device_Camera) -> FISHEYE624; then raw (x,y) -> display (H-1-y, x)
protocol.gate: mask_qa_pass==1 AND mask_hand_pose_available==1 AND finite landmarks AND finite headset pose
protocol.primary_subset: all 20 evaluated GT landmarks inside the image (all_in)
protocol.unmatched_landmarks: canonical PALM_CENTER (20) and MediaPipe THUMB_CMC (1) have no counterpart and are excluded
protocol.assignment: label-based: a GT hand takes the highest-handedness-score detection carrying its mapped label; 'geometric' instead takes the globally cheapest one-to-one pairing and is reported as an upper bound on localisation decoupled from labelling
protocol.distance: Euclidean distance from the RGB camera centre to the GT WRIST landmark, metres
protocol.norm_by: bounding-box diagonal of the 20 projected GT landmarks, px

handedness.question: does MediaPipe's image-space Left/Right label correspond to the wearer's left/right hand (identity) or is it mirrored (swapped)?

per_recording.note: mask_qa_pass False on every RGB frame; no frames exported
